items.title: 4 Big Tech earnings reports, a Fed meeting, and $100 oil: It's the busiest week of the quarter
items.summary: Investors step into the busiest week of the quarter with hyperscaler earnings, the June Fed meeting, and escalations in the Middle East all in focus.

items.title: Walmart Is at $108. Here's Why Investors Should Take Pause.
items.summary: Shares in this dominant retailer have climbed faster than Amazon and Costco in the past five years.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures Rise, Oil Prices Dive On Iran Hopes; Apple Leads Earnings Wave, Fed Meeting Ahead
items.summary: U.S.-Iran attacks have paused amid deal hopes. Apple, Amazon, Meta lead an earnings wave. A Fed rate hike is on the table.

items.title: Back to School Spending Expected to Set Records as Shoppers Hunt for Bargains
items.summary: Kids are heading back to the classroom, and the retailer trade group expects spending on supplies to hit a record $146.8 billion, more than Mother’s and Father's Day, Easter, and the Super Bowl combined.

items.title: Amazon Stock Just Hit a Major Hurdle Ahead of Earnings
items.summary: A Senate investigation has created fresh uncertainty for Amazon just days before earnings, but Wall Street remains focused on AWS growth and AI investments.

items.title: Fed Decision, Tech Earnings and Other Can't Miss Items this Week
items.summary: Markets face the week's most consequential moment Wednesday at 2:00pm when the Federal Reserve announces its rate decision and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh holds his first post-decision press conference, setting policy direction.

items.title: Neocloud Stocks vs. the Hyperscalers -- Who Actually Wins AI Capex Boom?
items.summary: The stakes are high as hundreds of billions of dollars flow into AI data centers.

items.title: Magnificent 7 Trade Is Broken — Here’s Where Smart Investors Should Look Next
items.summary: Buying all seven tech giants together made investors rich during the AI boom, but the basket trade has quietly become a drag on portfolios. Some of these companies are pulling ahead while others face serious questions about whether AI will ever pay off for them.
